product: Stealth 700 Gen 3 and Stealth Pro II battery (Airoha RACE, read only)
works: written from docs/brands/turtle-beach.md (halobattery-stealth700; HaloBattery PR #194 for the Stealth Pro II) and checked against simulated transmitters only (tests/sim-turtle-beach-battery.mjs)
reads: battery %, charging (key 250: confirmed on a Stealth Pro II, a best guess on the 700), headset linked, headset name, Signature Sound preset (raw)
Stealth 700 Gen 3: sends only the sheet's two fixed frames (CoAP enable 0x9942, GET /GSI in 0x9902)

Stealth Pro II (transmitter 229B, headset on its cable 229E): sends only the two frames from Swarm II's capture (the SInf session opener, then the GSI ask, both RACE 0x9902) and asks for the replies with GET_REPORT, as PR #194 does
steps back while Swarm II runs (it holds the channel)
reads replies as they arrive, then, if none came, asks for them with GET_REPORT exactly as the source's reader.py does
doesNotWork: any setting (no open source documents one on any Turtle Beach headset)
firmware updates and RACE nvkey writes (never)
the Stealth Pro II's third, inferred GSI ask (token 11 01, not in the capture): left out, so a read on battery may fail on some units
Stealth 600 Gen 3 (223A: its only source uses RACE nvkey commands, no battery read), Stealth 700 G2 and older headsets
